change_description: Baseline policy establishes authorised collection, access control, retention and incident-escalation requirements for employee information.
Version 2 introduces documented processing-purpose reviews, stronger third-party disclosure controls and mandatory periodic access reviews.
Version 3 adds formal evidence requirements for privacy requests, transfer assessments and incident-notification decisions.
Baseline policy establishes lifecycle controls for customer personal information and approved-system requirements.
Version 2 strengthens processor due diligence, access logging and security requirements for systems handling customer information.
Version 3 adds formal privacy-incident escalation criteria and documented assessment of notification obligations.
Baseline policy establishes retention schedules, legal-hold controls and secure disposal requirements.
Version 2 introduces periodic retention reviews and owner accountability for overdue records.
Version 3 strengthens evidence of deletion, archival and legal-hold release decisions.
Baseline policy establishes reporting, triage, containment and documentation requirements for data incidents.
Version 2 adds formal severity classification and mandatory coordination between security, privacy and legal teams.
Version 3 strengthens incident evidence, notification-decision records and post-incident corrective-action tracking.
Baseline policy establishes non-discrimination and fair-decision principles across employment activities.
Version 2 adds documented objective selection criteria and periodic review of employment decision processes.
Version 3 strengthens complaint escalation, investigation records and monitoring of potential unequal outcomes.
Baseline policy establishes standard recruitment, assessment, screening and candidate-record requirements.
Version 2 introduces documented evaluation criteria and additional review of screening and candidate-data handling.
Version 3 strengthens retention, access control and evidence requirements for recruitment decisions.
Baseline policy establishes confidential assessment and implementation of reasonable workplace adjustments.
Version 2 introduces formal request tracking, specialist review and implementation ownership.
Version 3 strengthens confidentiality controls and periodic review of accommodation arrangements.
Baseline policy establishes formal submission, investigation and resolution procedures for employee grievances.
Version 2 adds mandatory acknowledgement, investigator assignment and evidence-retention requirements.
Version 3 strengthens anti-retaliation controls, confidentiality and management reporting for unresolved cases.
Baseline policy establishes financial reporting preparation, reconciliation, review and supporting-record requirements.
Version 2 strengthens journal-entry approval, period-end controls and material-error escalation.
Version 3 adds enhanced evidence requirements for estimates, adjustments and audit support.
Baseline policy establishes tax filing, payment, documentation and ownership requirements.
Version 2 introduces a controlled tax calendar and formal review of material tax positions.
Version 3 strengthens retention, adviser oversight and escalation of uncertain or potentially non-compliant tax positions.
Baseline policy establishes expense submission, approval, reimbursement and supporting-document requirements.
Version 2 strengthens manager review and controls for unusual, related-party and controlled-category expenses.
Version 3 adds enhanced evidence and audit-trail requirements for expense exceptions and rejected claims.
Baseline policy establishes audit planning, evidence, findings and remediation controls.
Version 2 introduces risk-based audit planning and stronger governance escalation for significant control deficiencies.
Version 3 strengthens remediation tracking, evidence retention and follow-up of unresolved high-risk findings.
Baseline policy establishes payroll calculation, approval, validation, reconciliation and statutory reporting controls.
Version 2 strengthens controls over employee-master changes, bank details and compensation inputs.
Version 3 adds enhanced pre-payment validation, exception tracking and payroll-record access controls.
Baseline policy establishes employee-benefit eligibility, enrolment, administration and recordkeeping requirements.
Version 2 strengthens coordination between HR and payroll for benefit-related compensation and deduction changes.
Version 3 adds formal communication and evidence requirements for material benefit-plan changes.
Baseline policy establishes traceable records for compensation, salary changes, incentives, deductions and approvals.
Version 2 introduces periodic reconciliation between compensation records and approved HR data.
Version 3 strengthens access restrictions, discrepancy escalation and retention controls for compensation records.
Baseline policy establishes payroll audit scope, evidence, exception reporting and remediation requirements.
Version 2 expands audit testing to access rights, payment files and reconciliation controls.
Version 3 strengthens finding ownership, closure evidence and protection of sensitive payroll audit records.
Baseline policy establishes sourcing, evaluation, approval and recordkeeping controls for local procurement.
Version 2 adds documented assessment of local supplier and local procurement requirements.
Version 3 strengthens exception approval, supplier evidence and monitoring of changes in local procurement obligations.
Baseline policy establishes controls for property approvals, planning requirements, authority engagement and records.
Version 2 introduces formal pre-activity regulatory checks and approval tracking.
Version 3 strengthens documentation of authority correspondence, conditions, permits and follow-up actions.
Baseline policy establishes structured stakeholder identification, consultation and engagement records.
Version 2 introduces formal tracking of community concerns, commitments and responsible owners.
Version 3 strengthens evidence requirements where engagement forms part of a regulatory or planning obligation.
Baseline policy establishes a regulatory register, ownership model and monitoring process for local obligations.
Version 2 introduces formal impact assessments for new requirements and escalation of material compliance gaps.
Version 3 strengthens evidence of implementation, effective-date tracking and communication to affected policy owners.
